name: exp_centerofgravitycandle
summary: This EA trades based on the Center of Gravity indicator applied to candle data, entering positions when price deviates from the calculated center of gravity and expecting a reversion to the mean. It generates buy signals when the COG value is at the lower band and sell signals when at the upper band, typically using crossover or extreme-level detection for entries. The strategy systematically opens and closes positions based on these oscillator-style signals without discretionary input.
summary_zh: 该EA基于应用于K线数据的重心(Center of Gravity)指标进行交易,当价格偏离计算的重心时入场,预期价格将回归均值。在COG值处于下轨时产生买入信号,处于上轨时产生卖出信号,通过交叉或极值检测来确定入场时机。该策略系统性地根据振荡器类信号开仓和平仓,无需人工干预。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Center of Gravity(重心)指标,这是一个由John Ehlers开发的振荡器类指标,通过多项式回归计算价格的重心位置来判断市场的超买超卖状态。入场条件为:当COG指标从下轨区域向上穿越时开多单,表示价格从超卖区域开始回归;当COG指标从上轨区域向下穿越时开空单,表示价格从超买区域开始回归。出场条件通常依赖COG指标回到中轴或穿越中轴时平仓,也可能设置止损和止盈水平。仓位管理方面,EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式,具体取决于参数设置。资金管理方面,该EA可能缺乏动态调整仓位大小的机制,风险控制主要依赖止损设置。整体策略属于典型的均值回归类型,在震荡行情中表现较好,但在强趋势行情中可能连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Center of Gravity (COG) indicator, an oscillator developed by John Ehlers that uses polynomial regression to calculate the center of gravity of price, determining overbought and oversold market conditions. Entry conditions: buy when the COG indicator crosses upward from the lower band area, indicating price is reverting from oversold territory; sell when the COG indicator crosses downward from the upper band area, indicating price is reverting from overbought territory. Exit conditions typically rely on the COG returning to or crossing the zero line, though stop-loss and take-profit levels may also be configured. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or an equity-proportional calculation depending on parameter settings. Money management may lack a dynamic position-sizing mechanism, with risk control primarily dependent on stop-loss settings. The overall strategy is a classic mean reversion type that performs well in ranging markets but may suffer consecutive losses in strong trending conditions.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit distance in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 指标计算时间周期(0=当前周期)

pros: 基于数学回归模型的重心指标,理论基础扎实,具有统计学依据
均值回归策略在震荡行情中表现稳定,胜率较高
COG指标对价格转折点较为敏感,入场时机相对及时
策略逻辑清晰,参数较少,易于理解和优化
pros_en: Based on a mathematically grounded polynomial regression model with solid statistical foundation
Mean reversion strategy performs stably in ranging markets with relatively high win rates
COG indicator is sensitive to price turning points, providing timely entry signals
Clear strategy logic with few parameters, easy to understand and optimize
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中容易连续亏损,缺乏趋势过滤机制
默认参数下可能未设置止损,存在较大资金风险
缺少仓位动态调整机制,无法根据市场波动率自适应
COG指标存在重绘问题,历史回测结果可能不可靠
没有多时间周期确认,单一周期信号容易产生虚假突破
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy is prone to consecutive losses in strong trending markets, lacking a trend filter
Default parameters may not include stop-loss, posing significant capital risk
Lacks dynamic position sizing mechanism, unable to adapt to market volatility changes
COG indicator has repainting issues, making backtesting results potentially unreliable
No multi-timeframe confirmation, single timeframe signals are prone to false breakouts
improvements: 增加趋势过滤机制(如均线方向判断),在趋势行情中暂停交易或反转策略
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位管理,提高风险控制的适应性
加入多时间周期确认机制,减少虚假信号
增加重绘检测或使用非重绘版本的COG指标,确保回测可靠性
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to pause trading or switch strategy during trending markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss, take-profit, and position sizing for better risk adaptation
Add multi-timeframe confirmation to reduce false signals
Add repainting detection or use a non-repainting COG variant to ensure backtesting reliability

risk_points: 默认止损可能为0,存在无限亏损风险
COG指标重绘问题导致回测与实盘表现不一致
均值回归策略在趋势行情中缺乏保护机制,可能连续逆势加仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss may be zero, creating unlimited loss potential
COG indicator repainting causes discrepancy between backtest and live performance
Mean reversion strategy lacks protection in trending markets, risking consecutive counter-trend entries
